composition.summary: The agent discussed plan details before the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which are compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Luis, it's important to deliver the disclaimer before discussing any plan benefits to ensure compliance. In this call, the disclaimer was given after the agent discussed the plan details. Next time, make sure to deliver the disclaimer first.
